column1: # The photo fast path's name bank (v6.10): names the on-device image matcher compares a photo with.
# Every food of the app's own table (web-src/fit.js FOODS) is added automatically by tools/build_food_clip_bank.py;
# this file adds the extra visual names, dishes the table doesn't have, and things that are not food.
#   1. what a match means:  <id>  = that table food exactly (more names for it)
#                           ~<id> = a dish the table doesn't have; calories estimated from that table food, shown as an estimate
#                           -     = a dish found by name in the offline reader / food pack
#                           !     = not food (a face, a page, a screen…) → the photo goes to the usual chain
#   2. English names, "|"-separated; the first is the name shown (the image matcher reads English)
#   3. Arabic name shown on Arabic screens (empty for an exact table food: the table's Arabic is used)
